Civano Cycling Club Morning Rides

Tucson, AZ · Civano · Road

Civano Cycling Club Morning Rides is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls sundays and Tuesdays and Thursdays at 7:00 am from Civano Blvd and Drexel Rd (the club's usual meeting place).

For visitors

The page heading is 'Welcome All Cyclists'. Riders give their phone number and an emergency contact to the ride organizer before the start, by reply or text. The organizer's number is on the club's home page. Time and route go up the evening before, so check the page or the club's Facebook page the night before.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: not stated. The Oct 1 ride is about 35 miles to Kino Sports Complex and back..
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Civano Cycling Club Morning Rides group ride

A neighborhood club in southeast Tucson that rides three mornings a week from the corner of Civano Blvd and Drexel Rd. The October 1 ride is about 35 miles: Julian Wash west to Kino Sports Complex, a rest at Los Niños Park, then north on Rita Rd to Pour My Coffee. The site is still under construction and the club also posts on Facebook.
